problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 9 delivery trucks across 9 distribution centers.

Each truck must complete a specific route through the centers, represented as pairs (Center, Unloading time), where each pair specifies the distribution center where the truck must stop and the time required to unload its cargo. The sequence of pairs indicates the mandatory order of stops for each truck.

Truck routes:
* Truck 1 follows: (Center 8, 6) → (Center 3, 5) → (Center 7, 4) → (Center 2, 10) → (Center 1, 1) → (Center 5, 6) → (Center 9, 5) → (Center 4, 2) → (Center 6, 10)
* Truck 2 follows: (Center 3, 1) → (Center 2, 9) → (Center 4, 3) → (Center 1, 3) → (Center 7, 7) → (Center 9, 4) → (Center 8, 5) → (Center 5, 10) → (Center 6, 9)
* Truck 3 follows: (Center 1, 5) → (Center 9, 9) → (Center 2, 6) → (Center 8, 6) → (Center 5, 3) → (Center 3, 2) → (Center 7, 8) → (Center 4, 9) → (Center 6, 2)
* Truck 4 follows: (Center 2, 6) → (Center 3, 5) → (Center 9, 9) → (Center 8, 1) → (Center 4, 9) → (Center 7, 2) → (Center 6, 7) → (Center 5, 2) → (Center 1, 10)
* Truck 5 follows: (Center 7, 3) → (Center 8, 7) → (Center 9, 9) → (Center 1, 1) → (Center 6, 6) → (Center 4, 7) → (Center 3, 5) → (Center 5, 5) → (Center 2, 3)
* Truck 6 follows: (Center 2, 8) → (Center 8, 9) → (Center 5, 7) → (Center 3, 3) → (Center 7, 9) → (Center 9, 9) → (Center 6, 1) → (Center 1, 4) → (Center 4, 5)
* Truck 7 follows: (Center 9, 3) → (Center 4, 1) → (Center 3, 4) → (Center 1, 10) → (Center 5, 5) → (Center 7, 4) → (Center 8, 8) → (Center 2, 5) → (Center 6, 1)
* Truck 8 follows: (Center 1, 7) → (Center 7, 4) → (Center 4, 5) → (Center 5, 7) → (Center 9, 9) → (Center 2, 6) → (Center 3, 10) → (Center 6, 3) → (Center 8, 2)
* Truck 9 follows: (Center 6, 9) → (Center 4, 4) → (Center 9, 10) → (Center 1, 10) → (Center 8, 10) → (Center 5, 1) → (Center 2, 8) → (Center 3, 4) → (Center 7, 4)

Once a truck begins unloading at a center, the process must continue without interruption, and each distribution center can only accommodate one truck at a time. The objective is to schedule the unloading sequences at all centers so that the total time for all trucks to complete their routes is minimized.
